name: Shattered Hope: Three Houses
source:
The characters of Danganronpa F: Shattered Hope will be thrown into an Alternate Universe where they're in the Fire Emblem: Three Houses~!

Play as the mysterious new PROFESSOR in Garreg Mach Monastery and teach one of the three different houses presented!

[From [url=https://yaxicat.itch.io/shattered-hope-three-houses]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《弹丸论破F：破碎的希望》中的角色将被扔进异世界，他们在《火焰之纹章：三宫》中~！

扮演加尔格·马赫修道院的神秘新教授，教授三个不同学院之一！

[来自[url=https://yaxicat.itch.io/shattered-hope-three-houses]itch.io[/url]]
